purpose: verify that an exact repository commit and built submission package remain internally consistent while distinguishing human-policy HOLD from later identifier/release stages
checks: pyproject version matches release preflight and candidate tag
author metadata and approvals are evaluated without inference
journal-specific guide approval flag is explicit
release-tag and archive-DOI placeholder state is explicit
built submission package source_commit equals git HEAD
A-Islands and Tanzania fingerprints match the repository submission manifest
ci_mode: run after package build with --allow-hold; HOLD is acceptable only when internally consistent
